readout: p = sigmoid(plume_logits); pp = 2x2 mean pool of p (20 m grid); scene_score = max(pp); plume_present = scene_score >= scene_threshold; mask = (pp >= mask_threshold) if plume_present else empty; report the chip if the mask has >= min_mask_pixels_20m pixels
threshold_note: threshold (0.5) is the legacy single 10 m pixel threshold, kept for older tools. scene_threshold applies to scene_score only, never to single pixels. Thresholds were chosen on 2021 val data only.
